findings.entity: decorated egg in silver egg cup, right side of table
findings.description: At 00:04 two decorated eggs in silver egg cups are clearly visible on the right side of the table. At 00:00 and 00:02 only one egg cup is present in that region. Between 00:02 and 00:04 the camera framing is nearly static (the bowl and the first egg cup barely shift position), so the second egg cup cannot plausibly have entered the frame from off-screen; it appears with no explanation.
